$comment: Generated by `pnpm feature-spec` from src/core/features. Do not edit. Training reads this; the browser refuses a model whose code_hash differs.

features.name: blink_count
features.description: Blinks (80–500 ms closures) that ended in this second.

features.name: blink_duration_mean
features.description: Mean duration of blinks ending in this second; carried forward from the last blink if none, 0 before the first.

features.name: eyes_closed_fraction
features.description: Fraction of face frames with EAR below the blink threshold. Averaged over 60 s this is a PERCLOS proxy.

features.name: gaze_dispersion_x
features.description: Standard deviation of the horizontal iris offset.

features.name: gaze_dispersion_y
features.description: Standard deviation of the vertical iris offset.

features.name: gaze_centred_fraction
features.description: Fraction of face frames with the iris near its neutral position.

features.name: head_angular_speed
features.description: Mean angular speed of the head between consecutive face frames (rate-independent: divided by frame time).

features.name: brow_raise_mean
features.description: Mean brow height above the upper eyelids.

features.name: brow_inner_gap_mean
features.description: Mean distance between the inner brow ends; furrowing shows as a decrease.

features.name: lip_thickness_mean
features.description: Mean visible lip thickness; pressing the lips shows as a decrease.

validity.invalid_rows: set to 0 after z-scoring (the baseline mean); never interpolated

normalisation.baseline: first 60 valid seconds of the session (pilot study: the rest block)
